lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity white spots arranged in approximate vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with spots increasing in size towards the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs to form a visible checkerboard-like grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the lateral line; the primary ridge shows a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and a defined shadow gradient on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of small, high-luminance blobs scattered across the lower two-thirds of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, with the trailing edge showing a dark, spot-free gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple remoras (Echeneidae) attached ventrally to the pectoral fin and abdominal region; a faint vertical linear feature or possible healed scar is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of micro-spots on its dorsal surface compared to the larger, more spaced-out blobs on the primary lateral flank.
